newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ralston raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ralston raised to buy.

text.p: -- BT Securities analyst John O'Neil said Monday he upgraded Ralston Purina Co to a buy from a market performer.
-- He also raised his earnings estimate for Ralston, whose products include pet foods and batteries, to $3.78 a share for fiscal 1997 from $3.65.

-- The upgrade of Ralston followed stronger than expected earnings for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996. Ralston reported operating earnings on November 1 of $1.00 a primary share for the fourth quarter, up from $0.72 a year ago. The First Call consensus had been $0.79 a share.

-- O'Neil said the upgrade was also due to a recent pet food price increase, favorable commodity cost trends and Ralton's relatively inexpensive valuation to the food group on an earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) basis.
